description.p: ClipDeck keeps a searchable clipboard history in a compact Linux overlay. Pin useful clips, organize them into named boards, and move clips between boards with drag and drop.
Copy text and images back to the clipboard, edit text clips, and queue clips in a paste stack. Watching can be paused from the tray or Settings.

On GNOME Wayland, a system keyboard shortcut can open the overlay. Sensitive content is not automatically excluded when clipboard source identity is unavailable. Pause watching when handling private content.
